newsitem.title: USA: Lucent and Northern Telecom to make handsets - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Lucent and Northern Telecom to make handsets - NYT.

text.p: Except for the telephones themselves, Lucent Technologies and Northern Telecom are leading makers of almost everything needed to build wireless telephone networks, The New York Times reported Monday.
But now the two companies are investing hundreds of millions of dollars to make wireless handsets, the Times reported.
Their goals are identical: a fat piece of the rapidly growing global handset business, the Times reported.
And no matter who prevails in the handset war, companies like Anadigics Inc stand to gain, the Times reported.

The company makes a new type of chip - made from gallium arsenide rather than the more common silicone - that handset makers are turning to in order to make telephones smaller and more versatile, the Times reported.
